name: titan-nova-mme-migration
description: Migrate Amazon Bedrock embedding code from Titan Text Embedding V2 and Titan Multimodal Embeddings G1 to Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings (Nova MME). Handles all API differences: request schema, response parsing, embeddingPurpose selection, dimension mapping, client-side text+image fusion workaround, normalization changes, and binary embedding migration.

interface.shortDescription: Migrate Bedrock embedding code from Titan to Nova Multimodal Embeddings.
interface.longDescription: Step-by-step migration from Amazon Titan Text Embedding V2 and Titan Multimodal Embeddings G1 to Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings on Amazon Bedrock, with full API diff explanations and working migrated code.
defaultPrompt: Migrate my Titan embedding code to Nova Multimodal Embeddings.
How do I switch from amazon.titan-embed-image-v1 to Nova MME?
Update my code from Titan Text V2 to Nova embeddings.
